vibe: High-stakes lounge meets professional fintech dashboard. Premium, deep, and highly functional for rapid poker operations.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Control Room Grid for density with generous padding inside cards. Mobile-first but heavily optimized for tablet/desktop used in salons.

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:bg-primary-hover shadow-lg shadow-primary/20 transition-all active:scale-95 font-semibold
buttons.secondary: bg-secondary text-secondary-foreground hover:bg-secondary-hover transition-all active:scale-95 border border-border-default
buttons.danger: bg-danger text-danger-foreground hover:bg-danger-hover transition-all shadow-md shadow-danger/20

cards.dashboard_widget: bg-surface border border-border-subtle rounded-xl p-5 shadow-sm hover:border-border-default hover:-translate-y-0.5 transition-transform flex flex-col
cards.glass_panel: backdrop-blur-xl bg-glass border border-border-default shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(0,0,0,0.4)] rounded-xl

inputs.default: bg-surface-elevated border border-border-default rounded-md px-4 py-2 text-primary focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary/50 focus:border-primary transition-all placeholder:text-disabled
inputs.search: pl-10 rounded-full bg-surface-elevated border-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-primary

tables.container: w-full overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-border-subtle bg-surface
tables.header: bg-surface-elevated text-tiny text-secondary py-3 px-4 text-left border-b border-border-subtle

badges.success: bg-success-background_subtle text-success-hover border border-success/20 rounded-full px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-medium
badges.danger: bg-danger-background_subtle text-danger-hover border border-danger/20 rounded-full px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-medium
badges.warning: bg-warning/10 text-warning border border-warning/20 rounded-full px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-medium

image_urls.description: Playing cards with dark luxury background. Useful for login screen or empty state hero.
Vibrant stacks of casino chips on dark table. Good for dashboard headers or module illustrations.
Stacks of colorful poker chips on a green table ready for a game. Use for Cash Game module headers.

icons.usage: Use stroke-width 1.5 for a premium, delicate look. Icons should be sized 16px to 24px.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text meets minimum 4.5:1 ratio. The primary gold/amber on dark background is highly accessible.
accessibility.testid_convention: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='login-submit-button', data-testid='player-rebuy-action').

instructions_to_main_agent: Use Tailwind CSS for all styling.
Implement a dark theme layout globally (no light mode toggle required, default to dark).
For UI components like Dialogs, Tabs, Selects, and Tables, heavily utilize Shadcn UI. Customize their styling to match the provided colors and dark luxury vibe.
Do NOT use HTML <select> or native <input type='date'>; use Shadcn equivalents.
Use Recharts for financial dashboard charts. Ensure chart colors map to the provided success (green) and danger (red) hex codes.
Build a sidebar layout for navigation. The sidebar should use the glass panel style or a solid elevated surface (#1A1D24).
Add data-testid attributes to all buttons, inputs, links, and key metric displays.
Ensure quick actions (Buy-in, Rebuy, Add-on) have prominent CTA buttons (using the primary amber/gold color) in the Tournament/Cashier views.
